panels.description: 💡 How to use: 1) Click 'Your Favorite Movies' dropdown above, 2) Type movie name to search (e.g., 'Avengers', 'Matrix'), 3) Select 2-5 movies, 4) Choose strategy. The algorithm finds similar movies based on genre, director, franchise, budget tier, and release year. Current selection: Avengers: Endgame + Interstellar (default examples).
